problems_external_link_no_statement.name: problems_external_link_no_statement
problems_external_link_no_statement.value:
(
        "problems"."source_type" <> 'external_link'
        or (
          "problems"."external_url" is not null
          and "problems"."statement" is null
          and "problems"."input_format" is null
          and "problems"."output_format" is null
          and "problems"."constraints_text" is null
          and "problems"."examples" is null
          and "problems"."editorial" is null
        )
      )

solve_sessions_terminal_has_end.name: solve_sessions_terminal_has_end
solve_sessions_terminal_has_end.value:
("solve_sessions"."status" in ('active', 'paused')
        and "solve_sessions"."ended_at" is null and "solve_sessions"."ended_local_date" is null)
      or
      ("solve_sessions"."status" in ('solved', 'stuck', 'abandoned')
        and "solve_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "solve_sessions"."ended_local_date" is not null)

solve_sessions_speed_fields_consistent.name: solve_sessions_speed_fields_consistent
solve_sessions_speed_fields_consistent.value:
("solve_sessions"."revision_mode" = 'speed'
        and "solve_sessions"."speed_target_seconds" is not null and "solve_sessions"."speed_target_seconds" > 0
        and ("solve_sessions"."speed_target_met" is null or "solve_sessions"."status" in ('solved', 'stuck', 'abandoned')))
      or
      ("solve_sessions"."revision_mode" is distinct from 'speed'
        and "solve_sessions"."speed_target_seconds" is null and "solve_sessions"."speed_target_met" is null)

stuck_points_line_range_coherent.name: stuck_points_line_range_coherent
stuck_points_line_range_coherent.value:
("stuck_points"."line_start" is null and "stuck_points"."line_end" is null)
          or ("stuck_points"."line_start" is not null and "stuck_points"."line_end" is not null
              and "stuck_points"."line_start" >= 1 and "stuck_points"."line_end" >= "stuck_points"."line_start")

execution_jobs_claimed_lease_present.name: execution_jobs_claimed_lease_present
execution_jobs_claimed_lease_present.value:
"execution_jobs"."backend" = 'legacy' or "execution_jobs"."status" <> 'running'
          or ("execution_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "execution_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

execution_jobs_terminal_has_end.name: execution_jobs_terminal_has_end
execution_jobs_terminal_has_end.value:
("execution_jobs"."status" in ('queued', 'running') and "execution_jobs"."finished_at" is null)
      or
      ("execution_jobs"."status" in ('completed', 'failed') and "execution_jobs"."finished_at" is not null)

run_attempts_measurements_non_negative.name: run_attempts_measurements_non_negative
run_attempts_measurements_non_negative.value:
("run_attempts"."runtime_ms" is null or "run_attempts"."runtime_ms" >= 0)
          and ("run_attempts"."memory_kb" is null or "run_attempts"."memory_kb" >= 0)

run_attempts_tests_coherent.name: run_attempts_tests_coherent
run_attempts_tests_coherent.value:
("run_attempts"."tests_passed" is null and "run_attempts"."tests_total" is null)
      or
      ("run_attempts"."tests_passed" is not null and "run_attempts"."tests_total" is not null
        and "run_attempts"."tests_passed" >= 0 and "run_attempts"."tests_passed" <= "run_attempts"."tests_total")

run_attempts_server_verification_coheren.name: run_attempts_server_verification_coherent
run_attempts_server_verification_coheren.value:
("run_attempts"."server_verified" and "run_attempts"."server_verified_at" is not null and "run_attempts"."provider_name" is not null)
          or (not "run_attempts"."server_verified" and "run_attempts"."server_verified_at" is null)

interview_reports_publish_consent.name: interview_reports_publish_consent
interview_reports_publish_consent.value: "interview_reports"."status" <> 'published' or ("interview_reports"."original_and_nda_safe" and "interview_reports"."display_permission" and "interview_reports"."published_at" is not null)

problem_company_evidence_year_range.name: problem_company_evidence_year_range
problem_company_evidence_year_range.value: "problem_company_evidence"."year_from" is null or "problem_company_evidence"."year_to" is null or "problem_company_evidence"."year_to" >= "problem_company_evidence"."year_from"

problem_company_evidence_verified_source.name: problem_company_evidence_verified_source
problem_company_evidence_verified_source.value: "problem_company_evidence"."evidence_type" not in ('official_sample', 'verified_pyq') or ("problem_company_evidence"."source_url" is not null and "problem_company_evidence"."verification_status" = 'verified')
